Emily — thanks for the docs and for the clear summary. Quick checklist from our side so we can avoid back-and-forth:

1) Confirm the exact legal name (please reply if the name on the certificate should be normalized to Lumenix LLC / Inc).
2) Please provide a completed ACH/bank authorization (bank form) — we handle bank details as a separate secure intake.
3) Who should be the default invoice approver we should map in the system (name + email)?
4) Any entity-level tax withholding exceptions or VAT registration (not typical, but we ask).

For format: we store the legal name exactly as "Legal name" on the W-9 / certificate and capture a separate "Doing business as (DBA)" field if needed. Address should be split across address1/address2/city/state/zip.

I took the liberty of opening a HubSpot ticket (HS-4821) and a Drive folder — I'll share links after we validate. If you can send the ACH form and confirm the invoice approver, I can create the vendor record and route it to AP for final validation.

Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
